usedFor: Looker Studio (Google Data Studio) holds reports, and “Add members to Looker Studio asset” gives people access to one.

bestTemplate.name: “Add members to Looker Studio asset” in Looker Studio (Google Data Studio)
bestTemplate.why: It is the only step here, and it opens a report to a new person as soon as they join.

watchOut: Adding members shares a report with people, so keep it behind your approval when they sit outside the business.
